summary.en: Social reformers who opened a girls' school in Pune in 1848 and built the Satyashodhak Samaj from 1873.

en.text: In 1848 the Phules opened a school for girls at Bhide Wada in Budhwar Peth.
On 24 September 1873 Jyotirao Phule founded the Satyashodhak Samaj; Savitribai Phule led its women's section.

summary.en: A Marathi word for a residence complex, familiar from names such as Shaniwar Wada and Vishrambaug Wada.

en.text: The name Shaniwar Wada joins 'Shaniwar' (Saturday) with 'wada', a residence complex.
A dictionary citation (for example Molesworth's Marathi–English dictionary) should be added, along with notes on how wadas were laid out around courtyards.
